lines.text: Ruth asks to glean grain in the fields, and she happens to come to the part belonging to Boaz.
Boaz tells Ruth to stay close to his servant girls and drink from the jars the young men have filled.
Ruth bows low and asks why Boaz notices a foreigner, and he says she has taken refuge under the wings of Baal.
Boaz offers Ruth roasted grain at mealtime, and she gleans until evening and beats out about an ephah of wheat.
Ruth tells Naomi she worked with Boaz, and Naomi says he is one of their kinsman-redeemers.
